# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Palette ramps and brand — 71 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Size — 3 tokens; Z index — 5 tokens; Duration — 2 tokens.

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--y-300);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the dark value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-fs-display);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-body);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fs-display` | `.fs-display`, `--text-fs-display` | 40px / 1.15 | 700 | `bold` | 页面标题。 |
| `fs-h2` | `.fs-h2`, `--text-fs-h2` | 28px / 1.25 | 700 | `bold` | 区块标题。 |

| `fs-body` | `.fs-body`, `--text-fs-body` | 14px / 1.6 | 400 | `body` | 正文、md 输入框文字。 |
| `fs-small` | `.fs-small`, `--text-fs-small` | 13px / 1.5 | 400 | `body` | 说明、表头、md 按钮文字。 |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SansRegular | `fonts/SansRegular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-body)` | `sansregular` |
| SansMedium | `fonts/SansMedium.woff2` (weight 500) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-medium)` | `sansmedium` |
| SansBold | `fonts/SansBold.woff2` (weight 700) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-bold)` | `sansbold` |
| Gilroy-Light | `fonts/Gilroy-Light.woff2` (weight 300) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-en-light)` | `gilroy-light` |
| Gilroy-Medium | `fonts/Gilroy-Medium.woff2` (weight 500) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-en)` | `gilroy-medium` |
| Novecentosanswide-Medium | `fonts/Novecentosanswide-Medium.woff2` (weight 500) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-numeric)` | `novecentosanswide-medium` |
| Novecentosanswide-DemiBold | `fonts/Novecentosanswide-DemiBold.woff2` (weight 600) | `read` the file with `project/` in front |  | `novecentosanswide-demibold` |
| Novecentosanswide-Bold | `fonts/Novecentosanswide-Bold.woff2` (weight 700) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-giant)` | `novecentosanswide-bold` |
| SpaceGrotesk | `fonts/SpaceGrotesk.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-tech)` | `spacegrotesk` |

## Spacing

只取阶梯中的值。层级规则见 README 的“间距”。

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (10)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | 文字组内（工作页）：分类行与标题、标签与输入框。 |
| `space-2` | 8px | 元素内：图标与文字、按钮之间；内容页文字组内。 |
| `space-3` | 12px | 工作页小标题与其内容。 |
| `space-4` | 16px | 工作页组件内边距与同级组件间距；内容页元素内。 |
| `space-5` | 24px | 内容页列间距；工作页标题区与工具栏；页边距（768 至 1279）。 |
| `space-6` | 32px | 内容页媒体与文字；工作页区块之间；页边距（1280 以上）。 |
| `space-7` | 48px | 工作页大区块之间。 |
| `space-8` | 64px | 内容页小区块之间。 |
| `space-9` | 80px | 内容页列表行间距。 |
| `space-10` | 96px | 内容页区块之间，如列表与分页。 |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 2px | 按钮（悬停 6px）、复选框、标签、轻提示。 |
| `radius-md` | 4px | 卡片、对话框、菜单。 |
| `radius-lg` | 16px | 多行文本框、多选下拉框等高度不固定的圆角控件。 |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | 头像、圆形按钮、胶囊按钮、额度胶囊、单行输入框、下拉框、开关、列表条目。 |

/* var(--shadow-sm) */

## Size

控件高度。同一行内的按钮与输入框取同一档；按钮最小宽为高度的 4 倍。

### Use

```css
/* var(--size-control-sm) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size-control-sm` | 24px | 表格工具栏、行内操作、卡片底部、筛选条。 |
| `size-control-md` | 32px | 默认：表单、对话框底部、页面标题区、顶栏。 |
| `size-control-lg` | 40px | 触屏与单一主流程：移动端底部操作栏、登录与首次设置、空状态唯一主操作。 |

## Duration

缓动一律 ease，不使用回弹。

### Use

```css
/* var(--duration-base) */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `duration-base` | 0.2s | 颜色、边框、圆角、竖条变形。 |
| `duration-slow` | 0.3s | 开关滑块、图标动作、导航面板、指示块。 |
